result.reason: The clause appropriately covers Affiliates and contractors, but it does not itself make paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable or limit subscription termination to uncured material breach. Transferability to an M&A successor is also only made subject to an unseen Section 13.3 and therefore is not established by the provided operative language. Adding a new suspension right is unnecessary and potentially broader than the original revocation concept. The drafting otherwise preserves the core use right and unrelated commercial intent.
